## Checklist

- [ ] An issue describing the change was discussed first.
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), agreeing to the [Developer Certificate of Origin](https://developercertificate.org/).
- [ ] `terraform fmt -recursive` shows no changes.
- [ ] `terraform test` passes.
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test in `tests/`.
- [ ] `terraform-docs .` was run, and the README describes the change.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased".
- [ ] New `.tf` files start with the two-line header: `# Copyright 2026 Automate the Cloud Inc.` and `# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0`.
